verdict.rationale: Activepieces' AI agents can process live data from connected apps and produce summaries (e.g., 'summarise my unread emails every morning') and can search Slack/Drive/Linear in real time to answer questions, which is a limited form of AI-generated insight from user data. However there is no dedicated insights dashboard, proactive suggestion engine, or analytics feature — insights are only produced as ad-hoc outputs of manually configured agent tasks. missing for 10: dedicated data-insights/analytics UI, proactive/unprompted suggestions, independent evidence of insight quality.
